sample_data.method: Prisma seed from published JSON fixture (data/public.json) plus a direct JSON adapter for parity testing
sample_data.reset_instructions: Run `npm run db:push --force-reset` followed by `npm run db:seed` to restore the seeded households from prisma/seed.ts. The original public fixture is kept in data/public.json.

problem_solving_method: Implemented a pure Decimal.js tariff engine that replays each day in order (month reset on the 1st, recharge before daily deduction, fixed charges on the month's first recharge, VAT on energy). The same engine powers the balance chart, run-out projection, top-up advisor, habit comparison and monthly bill, so every screen reads off one source of truth.

R1.evidence: prisma/seed.ts seeds households with 6+ months of daily readings, including light months, heavy summer months and large last-week recharges; verified by __tests__/adapter.test.ts

R2.evidence: src/lib/engine.ts replay() implements the exact day loop, slab splitting, fixed charges and VAT; src/app/dashboard/page.tsx renders the balance line with recharge markers and month bands

R3.evidence: src/app/advisor/page.tsx calls engine.runsOut() and engine.topUpFor(), showing the run-out date and a four-part recharge breakdown (base, premium, fixed, VAT)

R4.evidence: src/app/habits/page.tsx and src/lib/engine.ts compareHabits() run both habits on identical consumption and calendar-month slabs, reporting cost (energy+VAT+fixed charges) and ties correctly; verified in __tests__/engine.test.ts

team_members.major_contribution: Main contributor — core implementation, UI and feature integration

major_design_decisions: Pure Decimal.js engine in src/lib/engine.ts keeps money exact and makes the tariff logic testable
Calendar-month slab counter reset on the 1st, not on recharge, matching the published fixture evidence
Fixed charges (demand + meter rent) are deducted only on a month's first recharge
Single replay array feeds every screen (dashboard, advisor, habits, bill) so results stay consistent
Next.js route groups separate public landing/auth pages from the protected dashboard
known_limitations: Custom household creation and 'paste your own history' are not yet exposed through the UI; only the seeded fixture households are browsable
The live deployment URL is not set in this manifest

ai_tools_used.used_for: Implementing the tariff engine, UI pages, auth flow and test suite based on the problem specification
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Ran `npm run lint`, `npm run build` and `npm test`; all 11 tests pass, including fixture parity and minimum-balance checks

declaration: The information above is complete and truthful to the best of the team's knowledge.
